input.quote: 15.4 Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement, neither Party makes any representation or extends any warranties of any kind either express or implied, including, but not limited to, warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, noninfringement or validity of any patents issued or pending
input.rationale: Article 15 contains only mutual and Array-specific representations given "as of the Effective Date" (15.1, 15.2), all of which are status/IP representations rather than a warranty of performance or conformity of what Array supplies. Section 15.4 then disclaims all other express and implied warranties, including merchantability and fitness. Product conformity is deferred entirely to future clinical/commercial supply and quality agreements (9.3, 9.4(b)(i)), which are agreements to agree and contain no warranty period or remedy today. There is therefore no conformance warranty, no warranty duration, and no repair/replacement or refund remedy anywhere in the Agreement, which fails the fallback position. We inserted the shortest express performance warranty at the fallback level (90 days for Materials against their specifications, 30 days for Array's services) with repair, replacement or refund, placed as new Section 15.5 so it is preserved by the "Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement" carve-out in 15.4.

ops.text: 15.5 Performance Warranty. Array warrants that (a) Materials supplied to Ono will conform in all material respects to their specifications for ninety (90) days following delivery, and (b) services performed by Array under this Agreement, including Development and Manufacturing activities, will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, for thirty (30) days following performance. Ono's remedy for breach of this Section 15.5 is, at Ono's election, repair, replacement or re-performance, or a refund of the amounts paid for the non-conforming Materials or services.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains only Effective Date representations and a broad disclaimer, with no conformance warranty or remedy for what Array actually supplies, so we added the fallback performance warranty: 90 days for Materials against their specifications, 30 days for Array's services, with repair, replacement or refund.
proposal.summary: Insert a short Array performance warranty (90 days for supplied Materials, 30 days for Array's services) with repair/replacement and refund remedies.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
